training: Use original fixed hyperparameters and seed; one fit per model/variant; train-only preprocessing; no tuning or early stopping; retain original full-input split membership, never rehash reduced inputs.
calibration: Sigmoid on logit(raw score), fitted on original 728 calibration rows for every variant; no choice of calibration method by validation results.
threshold: Choose max recall under FPR <= 0.02 on the same calibration partition, tie by precision then higher threshold. This partition also fits sigmoid: its performance is not independent. Freeze threshold before validation scoring; do not reuse the old validation-selected threshold.
capacity_ties: Original full-input group hash then source row ID; floor(N * share).
comparisons: All inputs minus each reduced variant within each model, and LightGBM minus logistic within each input variant. Report all, no winner selection or default replacement.

uncertainty.method: Paired resampling of original full-input validation groups with replacement, keep all rows per group; 95% percentile intervals for AP gain and Brier reduction; descriptive, no multiple-comparison adjustment, not new independent validation.

scope: Already-known historical development validation (429 rows). Never read test.npz, test-rows.json, report.json or raw archive; no new mailbox, future period, sender or semantic-text validation.
interpretation: Marginal value is conditional on other retained inputs and fixed training budget, not feature causality, acquisition cost, privacy compliance, or proof that a dropped input is useless. Reduced-input collisions are measured without changing membership.
